# Hypersnap libp2p-scatter compatibility patch

Source: crates.io `libp2p-scatter` 0.2.0 (the version used by the pinned
Informal Systems Malachite revision). Original license files are preserved.
The local change updates libp2p from 0.55 to 0.56 and prometheus-client from
0.22 to 0.23.1 so both Malachite transports share the application's patched
network stack.
